4600: Lie on your back with a small ball under one side of your lower back.
Bend your knees and keep your feet flat on the floor.
Shift your weight slowly so the ball rolls along the muscle next to the spine.
Pause on tender spots for a few breaths, then move on.
Switch sides and keep the pressure comfortable, never on the spine itself.
4601: Lie on your side with your knees bent and stacked, arms straight in front of you.
Keep your knees together and lift the top arm up and over.
Rotate your chest open toward the ceiling, following your hand with your eyes.
Return the arm and repeat, then switch sides.
4602: Hold a PVC pipe in both hands with your elbows tucked at your sides and bent to 90 degrees.
Keep your elbows pinned and rotate the pipe so one hand moves outward.
Return to the start and rotate the other way.
Move slowly and keep your ribs down and your wrists straight.
Continue alternating for the planned reps.
4603: Stand tall holding a PVC pipe across your upper chest in a front rack grip.
Lift your elbows forward and up as high as you comfortably can.
Keep your chest up and your lower back from arching.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
4604: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and a PVC pipe across your upper back.
Soften your knees slightly and push your hips straight back.
Lower your torso until you feel a stretch in the hamstrings, keeping your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall again.
Keep the pipe in contact with your head, upper back and tailbone if you can.
4605: Hold a PVC pipe vertically along your spine, one hand at the neck and one at the lower back.
Keep the pipe touching head, upper back and tailbone.
Push your hips back with soft knees and tip forward.
Stop when you feel the hamstrings stretch, then squeeze your glutes to stand.
Keep the pipe contact the whole time.
4606: Hold a PVC pipe overhead with a wide grip and arms locked out.
Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulders.
Squat down by sitting between your hips, keeping the pipe over your mid-foot.
Go as deep as you can with your chest up and heels down.
Drive through your feet to stand back up.
4607: Stand holding a PVC pipe in front of your thighs with a wide overhand grip.
Keep your arms straight and raise the pipe overhead.
Continue moving it down behind your back as far as comfortable.
Reverse the path back to the front with control.
Widen your grip if the shoulders feel pinched.
4608: Sit on the floor with both knees bent at 90 degrees, one leg in front and one to the side.
Sit tall and keep your hands on the floor if needed.
Rotate your knees to the other side so the legs swap positions.
Move smoothly without using your hands to push too hard.
Repeat back and forth for the set.
4609: Lie on your back with arms out to the sides and knees bent, feet flat.
Keep your shoulders on the floor.
Slowly drop both knees to one side as far as is comfortable.
Bring them back to the middle and drop them to the other side.
Move at an easy pace and breathe through each rep.
4611: Place a small ball between the back of your shoulder and a wall.
Lean in until you feel moderate pressure.
Roll slowly up, down and sideways over the rear deltoid.
Pause on tight spots for a few breaths.
4612: Stand with your back flat against a wall, feet slightly forward.
Start with arms straight down at your sides, palms forward.
Sweep your arms out to the sides and overhead in a wide arc, staying close to the wall.
Lower them back down the same way.
Keep your ribs and head against the wall.
4613: Stand with your back, head and hips against a wall, hands at shoulder height with elbows bent.
Brace your abs so your lower back stays on the wall.
Press your hands straight overhead until your arms are locked out.
Lower back to shoulder height with control.
Keep your wrists stacked over your elbows.
4615: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands on your hips.
Move your hips in a large smooth circle, as if drawing it with your belt buckle.
Do several circles one way, then switch direction.
Keep your shoulders still and relaxed.
4616: Stand tall with your arms out for balance or hands on your hips.
Shift your weight onto one foot.
Swing the other leg forward and up in a controlled kick, keeping it fairly straight.
Lower it with control without leaning back.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.
4617: Stand facing a wall at arm's length and place one hand on it at chest height.
Keep your other arm behind your back or at your side.
Bend your elbow to lower your chest toward the wall, body in a straight line.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
4618: Stand on the band with feet hip-width apart and grab it with both hands.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and slightly bent knees.
Lower your hands along your legs until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall and squeeze your glutes.
Keep the band close to your body.
4619: Stand on the band and hold the ends with palms facing each other.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl your hands up toward your shoulders without turning your wrists.
Lower slowly back to the start.
4620: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands lightly behind your head.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Rotate your torso to bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Lower with control and repeat on the other side.
4621: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your shoulders, palms facing in.
Press the dumbbells overhead at the top.
Lower them to your shoulders and roll back down slowly.
Keep your feet planted, or anchor them if needed.
4622: Start in a forearm or high plank with a dumbbell in one hand.
Brace your abs and keep hips level.
Lift the dumbbell forward in line with your torso.
4623: Sit on the floor holding a weight at your chest, leaning back slightly with legs extended.
Lift your feet off the floor.
Pull your knees in while bringing your chest forward.
Extend your legs again without touching the floor.
Keep your back long and breathe steadily.
4624: Lie on your back with knees bent and a dumbbell held against your chest.
Curl your head and shoulders off the floor.
4625: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding dumbbells at your shoulders.
Sit up and rotate your torso to one side.
Rotate back to center and press the dumbbells overhead.
Lower them to your shoulders and roll back down.
4626: Sit on the floor holding a dumbbell at your chest and lean back slightly.
Extend your legs and lift your feet off the floor.
Pull your knees in toward your chest.
Extend your legs back out under control.
4627: Start in a high plank with a dumbbell in one hand.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Lift the dumbbell forward and the opposite leg back at the same time.
4628: Sit on the floor holding a dumbbell at your chest and lean back slightly.
Lift your feet off the floor.
Pull your knees in and rotate your torso to one side.
Extend your legs and rotate back to center.
4629: Start in a high plank with your hands on dumbbells.
Row one dumbbell to your hip, keeping hips level.
Lower it, then hop or step your feet toward your hands.
Stand up with the dumbbells and squat down.
Return to plank and alternate the rowing arm.
4630: Stand tall and hold a wall or support for balance.
Swing the other leg across your body, then out to the side.
Keep your torso upright and the swing controlled.
Do your reps, then switch legs.
4631: Lie face down with your arms out to the sides.
Bend one knee and swing that foot up and across your body.
Reach toward the opposite hand and keep shoulders on the floor.
4633: Step into a long lunge with both hands on the floor inside your front foot.
Rotate your chest toward the front leg and raise that arm.
Return the hand to the floor and straighten the front leg.
4634: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Drive one knee up to hip height.
Lower it and kick the same heel toward your glutes.
Alternate sides at a steady, light pace.
Keep your core braced and stay on the balls of your feet.
4646: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and lean back slightly.
Cross your hands over your chest.
Lift your feet slightly off the floor if you can.
Rotate your torso to one side, then to the other.
Move with control and keep your chest lifted.
4653: Stand next to a wall or support and hold it with one hand.
Raise the opposite knee to hip height.
Lower it and kick that heel up toward your glutes.
Switch sides and keep your torso upright.
4658: Start in a kneeling push-up position with hands under your shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up to straight arms.
Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder, then switch.
Keep your hips steady and repeat.
4663: Lie face down with your arms by your sides, palms up.
Lift your chest and arms slightly off the floor.
Raise your hands up and back by squeezing your shoulder blades.
4665: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and arms at your sides.
Raise both arms out to the sides and overhead.
Clap your hands above your head.
Lower your arms back to your sides with control.
Keep your ribs down and move smoothly through your reps.
4667: Place your hands on a bar or sturdy surface at about waist height, shoulder-width apart.
Walk your feet back and lean forward in a plank.
Bend your elbows and lower your head between your arms.
Keep your elbows pointing forward and your body straight.
Press back up by extending your arms and repeat.
4669: Kneel upright with your hips over your knees and your arms by your sides.
Sit your hips back toward your heels.
Drive your hips forward, squeezing your glutes.
Stand tall at the top without leaning back.
4671: Stand with feet wider than hips and arms overhead.
Reach up and over to one side.
Return to center and reach to the other side.
Let your torso rotate slightly as you go.
4672: Stand tall with your hands behind your head and elbows pointing out.
Draw your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
4673: Stand or kneel with one foot forward in a lunge position.
Tuck your pelvis under and squeeze the back glute.
Lean slightly forward to feel the stretch at the front of the hip.
4674: Place the top of your back foot on a bench behind you.
Step your front foot forward into a lunge.
Tuck your pelvis and push your hips forward.
Keep your chest tall and hold for 20-30 seconds.
4675: Shift your weight to one side and sit into a side lunge.
Straighten the other leg and feel the inner thigh stretch.
Push off to hop to the other side.
Continue alternating at a controlled pace.
4677: Get on all fours with a band looped around your foot and hands.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Extend one leg back, squeezing your glute.
Return with control and repeat, then switch legs.
4678: Stand on the band holding the other end with both hands.
Hinge your hips back with a flat back.
Drive your hips forward to swing your arms up to chest height.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
4679: Stand on the band with your front foot and hold the other end at your shoulders.
Step your other foot back into a split stance.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee stable.
Drive up through the front foot, then switch legs after your set.
4680: Anchor the band overhead and hold the ends with both hands.
Keep your elbows tucked at your sides.
Press your hands down until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your triceps at the bottom.
Let your hands rise slowly and repeat.
4681: Lie on your back and loop the band around the soles of your feet, holding the ends.
Bend both knees toward your chest.
Press one foot out straight against the band.
Bring it back and press the other leg.
4682: Stand on the band and hold the ends in each hand.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Raise your arms out to the sides with slight elbow bends.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
4683: Stand on the band with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the ends at your shoulders.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit your hips back and down.
Go to at least parallel without letting your knees cave in.
Drive up through your heels and repeat.
4684: Anchor the band low behind you and kneel facing away from it.
Hold the ends at chest height.
Press your hands up and forward at an incline.
Squeeze your chest at the top.
Return slowly with control and repeat.
4685: Stand on one end of the band and hold the other end at your side.
Bend sideways at the waist away from the band.
Squeeze your obliques and return upright.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
4686: Stand on the band and hold the ends behind your head at shoulder level.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.
Lock out your arms without shrugging.
Lower slowly back behind your head and repeat.
4687: Stand on the middle of the band and hold the handles with palms facing in.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl the handles up toward your shoulders.
4688: Anchor the band high and hold the handles with elbows bent at your sides.
Press the handles down until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your triceps for a moment.
4689: Stand in a split stance with the band under your front foot and handles at your shoulders.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Press through the front heel to rise.
Complete your reps and switch legs.
4690: Lie on your back with knees bent and one ankle crossed over the other knee.
Lift your hips until your body forms a line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
4691: Kneel on all fours with hands under shoulders.
Lift one leg out to the side, bent.
Extend it into a kick out to the side.
Bend it back in and lower.
Finish the reps and switch legs.
4692: Start on all fours with a flat back.
Lift one bent knee back and up.
Swing the leg out to the side into a kick.
4693: Start on all fours, hands under shoulders.
Lift one leg out straight behind you.
Sweep it in a half circle out to the side.
Keep your hips square and switch sides.
4694: Stand on the band and hold the ends behind your head with elbows bent.
Squeeze your triceps at the top.
4695: Stand on the band and hold the other end in one hand at your thigh.
Keep your elbow leading the movement.
Pull your hand up toward your chest, elbow higher than the wrist.
Lower slowly, then repeat and switch arms.
4696: Anchor the band low and stand sideways to it, holding the end with both hands.
Start with your hands near the low hip.
Pull diagonally upward across your body as you rotate your torso.
Pivot your back foot and keep your arms long.
Return slowly, repeat, then switch sides.
4697: Anchor the band overhead and hold the ends with both hands.
Stand with a slight bend in your knees.
Pull your arms down and back past your hips.
Squeeze your lats and keep your core braced.
4698: Stand on the band and hold the ends, hinging forward with a flat back.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Row your elbows back toward your hips.
4699: Lie on your back with the band looped around your feet and hold the ends.
Raise your legs and shoulders slightly off the floor.
Pedal one leg in while extending the other.
Twist your torso to bring the opposite elbow to the knee.
Keep a steady rhythm and keep your core tight.
